datasets.label: Squash glucose
datasets.description: Field-grown Cucurbita pepo leaf spectra under source–sink and water-stress treatments, with glucose as the response.
datasets.provenance: EcoSIS dataset 10.21232/RLmYbmE3 (CC BY); deterministic subset of 90 calibration and 30 untouched validation spectra.

datasets.label: Crop nitrogen
datasets.description: Leaf spectra and biochemical traits from eight crop species, with dry-mass nitrogen percentage as the response.
datasets.provenance: EcoSIS dataset 10.21232/C2GM2Z (ODC-By); deterministic subset of 90 calibration and 30 untouched validation spectra.

datasets.label: Leaf water stress
datasets.description: Tabletop leaf dry-down spectra from multiple species, with measured leaf water potential as the response.
datasets.provenance: EcoSIS dataset 10.21232/egGyynzX (PDDL); deterministic subset of 90 calibration and 30 untouched validation spectra.
